setup_admin_intro: Create the instance administrator account. You can invite others afterwards.
setup_org_intro: Your organization's details, used on invoices, emails, and throughout the app.
setup_org_iban_hint: Optional. A Swiss QR-IBAN enables QR-bill invoicing.
setup_locales_intro: Choose which languages are active on this instance, and check email delivery.
setup_finish_seed_roles: Create the default roles (Admin, Board, Treasurer, Warehouse manager, Event manager, Volunteer, Read-only)
setup_finish_success: Setup complete. Sign in with the admin account you just created.
forgot_password_intro: Enter your email address — if it matches an account, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
forgot_password_sent: If that address matches an account, you'll receive an email shortly.
forgot_password_unavailable: Password reset by email isn't available on this instance. Contact an administrator.
reset_password_invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
reset_password_success: Password reset. You can now sign in.
invite_accept_intro_new: You've been invited to join {orgName}. Choose your name and a password to create your account.
invite_accept_intro_existing: Choose a new password for your account.
invite_accept_invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
users_invite_email: Email of the person to invite
users_invite_link_ready: No email provider configured: copy this link and send it yourself.
users_reset_password_result: Temporary password: {password} — share it with the person directly.
roles_system_locked: Default role: permissions can be edited, but it can't be deleted.
roles_delete_confirm_body: Users with this role will lose the permissions it grants.
twofactor_intro: Add an extra layer of security to your account with an authenticator app.
twofactor_scan_qr: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the generated code.
twofactor_backup_codes_intro: Keep these somewhere safe — each can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
email_invite_body: You've been invited to join {orgName} on Arnia. Use the link below to create your account.
email_reset_body: We received a request to reset your account's password. Use the link below to choose a new one. If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
email_change_body: Use the link below to confirm the new email address for your Arnia account.
email_footer_note: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
inventory_empty_body: Add your first inventory item to get started.
item_photo_unsupported: Unsupported file type. Use a photo (JPEG, PNG, WEBP or HEIC).
movement_item_search_placeholder: Search by name, SKU or barcode
movement_reason_required: A reason is required for this movement type.
location_delete_confirm: Locations inside it are deleted too. Items stored here will no longer have a location.
category_delete_confirm: Subcategories are deleted too. Items in this category will no longer have a category.
scan_intro: Point the camera at an item's barcode or QR code to find it quickly.
scan_camera_denied: Camera access denied. You can also search for the item manually.
scan_not_found: No item found with that code.
count_intro: Scan or search each item and enter the counted quantity.
common_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
common_error_not_found: Not found — it may have been deleted.
common_error_network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
error_403_description: You don't have permission to view this page. Ask an administrator if you think this is a mistake.
error_404_description: What you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.
error_500_description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again in a moment.
home_placeholder_title: The dashboard is coming in a later version.
home_placeholder_body: Use the menu to manage inventory, or the + button for quick actions.
item_created: Item created. You can add photos now.
item_archive_confirm_body: The item disappears from active lists, but its history is kept. You can restore it at any time.
item_unit_error: Enter a unit, e.g. pcs (max. 20 characters).
item_min_threshold_error: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
item_photo_storage_unavailable: File storage isn't set up yet. Ask an administrator.
item_photos_empty_edit: Add a photo so the item is recognisable at a glance.
movement_item_required: Choose an item from the list.
movement_qty_error: Enter a whole quantity greater than 0.
count_qty_error: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
scan_camera_unavailable: No camera available (or another app is using it). You can also search for the item manually.
scan_camera_insecure: The camera only works over a secure (HTTPS) connection. You can also search for the item manually.
locations_empty: No locations yet. Create one above.
categories_empty: No categories yet. Create one above.
users_invite_created: Invitation created — copy the link below.
users_revoke_confirm_body: The invitation link will stop working.
users_deactivate_confirm_body: They won't be able to sign in until you reactivate them. Their data is kept.
users_cannot_deactivate_self: You can't deactivate your own account.
users_reset_confirm_body: Their current password stops working immediately. You'll get a temporary password to pass on.
roles_duplicate: A role with this name already exists.
twofactor_invalid_code: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
twofactor_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
invite_accept_done_existing: Password set and roles updated — you can sign in now.
setup_org_country_invalid: Use the 2-letter country code, e.g. CH.
setup_org_currency_invalid: Use the 3-letter currency code, e.g. CHF.
item_photos_upload_on_save: Photos are uploaded when you save the item.
item_photos_saved_immediately: Photos are saved right away — no need to press Save.
item_created_photos_failed: Item created, but {count} photo(s) couldn’t be uploaded. You can add them from Edit.
